name: popnow
description: Agent Skills for the PopNow AI API: generate videos, images, music and speech, apply trending video effects, make launch films, explainer videos, landing pages, social covers and brand kits, and find free ready-made style presets. Every paid generation is quoted first.

interface.shortDescription: AI video, image and music generation, launch films, explainers, landing pages and brand kits
interface.longDescription: Generate AI videos (text-to-video and image-to-video), images, music and speech with the PopNow API, apply trending video effects to a photo, and let your agent make finished work: a product launch film from a README, a narrated explainer video with timed captions, a landing page designed from AI mockups, exact-size social covers and thumbnails, and a brand kit delivered as a DESIGN.md. You can also find free ready-made style presets. Skills are free; generations spend PopNow credits and are always quoted and confirmed first. Needs a PopNow API key in POPNOW_API_KEY for generation.
defaultPrompt: Turn this photo into a 5-second video with a slow camera push-in
Find a style for a product launch video and make it with me
Make an upbeat synth-pop track for my intro
